MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WHERE CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) = 0
  AND p.position <> 'Backcourt'
  AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <> 1989
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) = 0
  AND (p.position IS NULL OR p.position <> 'Backcourt')
  AND (t.founded_year IS NULL OR CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <> 1989)
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND p.olympic_gold_medals = '0'
  AND p.position IS NOT NULL
  AND p.position <> 'Backcourt'
  AND t.founded_year IS NOT NULL
  AND t.founded_year <> '1989'
WITH t, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_titles
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, avg_titles AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE (r.tenure = 'latest' OR r.tenure = 'current' OR r.tenure IS NULL)
  AND p.olympic_gold_medals = '0'
  AND p.position IS NOT NULL
  AND p.position <> 'Backcourt'
  AND t.founded_year IS NOT NULL
  AND t.founded_year <> '1989'
WITH t, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_titles
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, avg_titles AS col2
